import json,sys
s=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print(list(s.keys()))
print('schema',s.get('schema_version'),'hp',s.get('hearing_progress'))
print('targets',s.get('targets'))
print('foundation confirmed',s['requirements_foundation'].get('confirmed'), s['requirements_foundation'].get('approval_ref'))
print('decisions',[(d.get('id'),d.get('status')) for d in s.get('decisions',[])])
cells=[(c,p,v.get('state')) for c,row in s['matrix'].items() for p,v in row.items()] if isinstance(s.get('matrix'),dict) else None
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x[2] for x in cells) if cells else s.get('matrix')[:1])
print('qa',len(s['qa_log']),'appr',len(s['approval_log']))
PY
for m in "" "--require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation"; do python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py" --matrix "$S" $m | tail -c 400; echo "exit=$?"; done
python3 -B "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/validate-knowledge-graph.py" --profile required-info --input "$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/run-system-spec-elicit/references/required-info-catalog.json" --state "$S" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('collection_order'));print(d.get('coverage_certificate',{}).get('ungrounded_blocking_items'))"; echo "kg_exit=${pipestatus[1]}"
